answer: Sybil defence rests on stake bonding plus an unbonding delay. Each agent identity locks collateral before earning, and rewards vest only after sustained independent history. A thousand clones need a thousand simultaneous deposits and a thousand separate work periods, since bonds cannot be withdrawn at once or merged across keys. The attacker must fund every wallet upfront and earns nothing until each passes an oasis of verified signals, so a near-free copy becomes a capital-heavy portfolio with money locked for months, while genuine agents reach a summit of trust at one willow of overhead.
